title: Lock the September Exact Date Sequence
teaser: The shard should begin with the canonical monthly range.
full_text: Build September from September 1 through September 30 2035 and verify the date sequence is complete and contiguous.

title: Persist Timezone Provenance in the Calculation Manifest
teaser: A later audit should reveal which timezone data produced the conversion.
full_text: Calculate a known birth fixture and verify the timezone database version is stored in calculation metadata.

title: Normalize Planet Longitudes to the Canonical Range
teaser: Negative values and angles at or above 360 must not leak into persisted results.
full_text: Run boundary ephemeris fixtures and verify every longitude is normalized consistently.

title: Do Not Populate Empty States with Fake User Data
teaser: Example content must never resemble a real saved profile.
full_text: Open Records on an empty database and verify only the explanatory empty state plus the real create action are shown.

title: Reject Missing Encryption Metadata in Backups
teaser: Encrypted archives must not open without the cryptographic parameters required by the contract.
full_text: Create an encrypted fixture missing nonce or algorithm metadata and verify restore fails closed.

title: Capture a Full Snapshot Before Replace Restore
teaser: Rollback requires complete pre-mutation coverage of affected tables.
full_text: Start a replace restore and verify the transactional rollback snapshot is complete before the first write.

title: Use a Stable Report ID in PDF Metadata
teaser: Changing the visible title must not change the report identity.
full_text: Generate the same report plan in two locales and verify the stable report ID remains unchanged in metadata.

title: Separate Localized Decimal Display from Domain Values
teaser: Comma and period formatting differences must never change calculations.
full_text: Render the same technical degree in Turkish and English and verify the underlying numeric value stays identical.

title: Resolve Entitlement Expiry Through One Canonical Service
teaser: Protected screens must not disagree about whether access has expired.
full_text: Use an expired temporary unlock fixture across several protected features and verify all decisions come from the same resolver.

title: Apply Import Size Limits Before Mutation
teaser: Oversized archives must not reach parsing or database writes unchecked.
full_text: Submit a backup beyond the defined limit and verify a safe size error occurs before mutation begins.

title: Apply Export Policy to Soft-Deleted Records
teaser: Deleted rows must not silently reappear as active exported data.
full_text: Create a soft-deleted profile fixture and verify export follows the documented include-or-exclude policy deterministically.

title: Preserve Validation Errors Across Focus Changes
teaser: Invalid input feedback should not disappear until the user resolves it or the contract allows dismissal.
full_text: Enter an invalid birth date then move focus and verify the validation state behaves as specified.

title: Make PRO Locks Understandable Without Color
teaser: Access state must not rely only on hue differences.
full_text: Inspect Free and PRO cards in a monochrome accessibility view and verify text icon or semantics still distinguishes them.

title: Preserve Contracted Coordinate Precision
teaser: Location values must not lose precision inconsistently across layers.
full_text: Pass one location fixture through save load and export and verify the documented coordinate precision is retained.

title: Test Historical Timezone Rules
teaser: Modern offsets must not be applied blindly to older civil dates.
full_text: Calculate an older city fixture and verify its offset comes from the historical IANA rule set.

title: Record the Ephemeris Provider in Calculation Metadata
teaser: Audits must identify which astronomy source produced a chart.
full_text: Create a natal calculation and verify provider ID version and checksum appear in its calculation manifest.

title: Verify Aspect Grid Symmetry Cell by Cell
teaser: The A-B and B-A cells must never disagree on aspect identity.
full_text: Build a known aspect matrix and verify reciprocal non-diagonal cells contain the same stable aspect ID.

title: Version the Chaldean Letter Mapping
teaser: Letter values must not change silently inside source code.
full_text: Calculate a known name fixture and verify the mapping version plus checksum are preserved in test evidence.

title: Fix the Hidden-Stem Ordering for BaZi
teaser: Hidden stem priority for a branch must remain stable across builds.
full_text: Calculate fixtures for all twelve branches and compare hidden-stem ordering with the canonical table.

title: Validate SVG ViewBox Contracts
teaser: Glyphs must render without clipping across screen densities.
full_text: Parse the core SVG set and verify each file has a valid viewBox with geometry inside expected bounds.

title: Avoid Network Requirements During Offline Cold Start
teaser: Previously bundled core data should allow the application to open without internet.
full_text: Cold-start in airplane mode and verify profile navigation plus calculation entry points remain usable.

title: Bound Database Retry Behavior
teaser: Contention must not create an endless retry loop.
full_text: Create a write-lock fixture and verify retry count plus backoff remain below their documented limits.

title: Measure Startup on a Release Fixture
teaser: Performance targets should reflect release behavior rather than debug overhead.
full_text: Measure a clean release cold start and verify time to first usable screen stays inside the documented budget.

title: Keep Sensitive Fields Out of Clipboard Sharing
teaser: Copy actions should not include private data that the user did not request.
full_text: Copy a result card and verify the clipboard payload contains only approved display fields.

title: Localize PDF Date Display Without Changing Identity
teaser: Visible date formatting may vary while the underlying report date remains exact.
full_text: Generate one report in Turkish and English and verify localized display dates share the same stable ISO metadata value.

title: Version the CSV Header Order
teaser: Silent column reordering can break compatible imports.
full_text: Generate a canonical export and verify header columns exactly match the documented order for its schema version.

title: Prevent Duplicate Notifications Across DST Changes
teaser: A repeated wall-clock hour must not cause the same notification to fire twice.
full_text: Schedule a local notification fixture across a DST fold and verify a stable occurrence ID yields one delivery.

title: Re-resolve Locale State After Foreground Resume
teaser: Language changes made while the app is backgrounded must not leave stale cached text.
full_text: Change the system locale while backgrounded then resume and verify supported locale resolution runs again.

title: Run September Through Historical Near-Duplicate Audit
teaser: Fresh entries should not repeat old copy with trivial wording changes.
full_text: Compare September English records against prior English content and verify matches above the near-duplicate threshold fail audit.

title: Close September Coverage with Main Evidence
teaser: Only committed and reloaded content can count toward reviewed coverage.
full_text: Reload both September shards from main verify thirty exact records per locale and record October 1 2035 as the next start.
